name: 98119 · Seattle, WA
findings: ZIP 98119 (Seattle) has 128 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98119 (Seattle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98119 (Seattle) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
